text:
maria: Quick sync — planning next RFC review slot (weekly). Thinking Thu 10:00am PT, 45m. We have 4 authors queued. Who can cover reviewer duties and who can present? I want to make sure rollout/traffic-affecting RFCs have SRE coverage.

zach: I can present the model-onboarding RFC and review the quantization one.

devon: I'm OOO Tue/Wed but I can make Thu 10. Happy to review autoscaler before the meeting.

sarah: I prefer 11am PT but OK to do 10 if it keeps things tight. Also still waiting on autoscaler pre-read link — didn't see it in the doc list.

maria: Ah sorry — uploaded the autoscaler pre-read last night: https://drive.company/rfc/autoscaler — short checklist I added in the top: TL;DR, open questions, decision needed. Please add one-line risks if you touch routing/capacity.

matt: I'll be there. Can we order the agenda so the two short API tweaks are first? Gets us a couple of quick closes.

devon: +1 to that ordering. Suggested order: 1) API minor tweaks (15m) 2) quantization config (20m) 3) autoscaler (25m) 4) rollout policy (10m). Leaves room for follow-ups.

oncall-bot: Reminder: If an RFC impacts serving or fallbacks, add "impact_to_sre: yes" in the frontmatter and tag @eng-sre.

maria: Good call. I'll re-run the agenda with that order and ping authors. Action items for authors: add 1-slide summary and call out decisions needed by Wed EOD.

maria: Also, please add a quick availability tag in this thread so I can slot presenters: can_present / can_review / prefer_skip. @zach @devon @matt @sarah

zach: can_present, can_review

matt: can_review

devon: can_present, can_review

sarah: can_present if 11, can_review if 10 works

maria: Noted — I'll keep it at 10 for now and send the invite with agenda + links. If anyone absolutely needs 11, DM me and I'll try a swap. Thanks everyone — I'll post the final agenda + the meeting doc in this thread when it's set. :thumbsup:
